verdict.rationale: The evidence shows models can be loaded from the command line with `local-ai run` (Hugging Face and Ollama URIs), and that `--preload-models` takes a JSON list of model parameters. GPU handling is described only as automatic detection and backend download, not as user-tunable offload. Missing for 10: any documented CLI flag or setting for GPU layer offload, any documented context-length setting at load time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
